compiled_kernel_resources.scope: Static compiler declarations, not measured occupancy or instruction throughput.

implementation: Three256-thread scalar QK schedules assign1x2,2x1 or2x2 independent scores per thread, producing16x32,32x16 or32x32 output tiles. Cooperative128-feature Q/K staging is amortized across more cells; a query operand is loaded/decoded once for its two key columns. The existing packed BF16/exponent representation, exact scalar products, maximum exponent, modulo addition, normalization and ascending K16 carries remain unchanged. Each cell independently marks unsupported operands or endpoints, and the unchanged complete original-dot scan replaces every marker. Retained inline and original deferred kernels are controls. No product dispatch changes.
correctness_scope: All120 generated configurations compare every raw score and64 independent wide CPU dots, including partial tiles at31/32/33 rows, causal masks, zeros, unsupported exponents, late fallback, overflowing endpoints and an invalid operand in only the second cell of a thread. Every captured score buffer, unused tail and guard matches original canonical arithmetic after each warmup and sample. Independent CPU encoding checks cover all prepared rows/flags; original/prepared inputs remain immutable. q8192 repeats1023 source rows. No external attention-context comparison, model tokens or numerical threshold changes are claimed.
timing_scope: Completed host slab clocks include the candidate and full original fallback scan. All arms add the same one-time full Q/K preparation and key transpose. Allocation, resets, reference computation and observation are outside clocks. Five arms rotate across128-query slabs, each with one warmup and three samples. These clocks do not measure model load or TTFT.

decision.decision: Advance the exact2x2 schedule into a combined default-off attention experiment with the previously verified native EXP correction. It preserves every original raw score and reduces captured q8192 QK353.4056 to300.9476ms, compared with327.1309ms for the unchanged deferred control. q7169 likewise improves268.4733 to233.8882ms. These are component clocks, not model TTFT, and do not yet justify runtime retention. Test the complete attention owner and real GB10 continuation before any product decision; avoid further isolated tile-size tuning while the10000ms mission gate is open.
limitations: One native process per shape, three rotated completed samples per arm.
q8192 repeats1023 captured rows and supplies no new prompt or model-token result.
